description: Defines a data transfer object class ReportingMethodSearchFilterParams used for search filtering related to reporting methods within the OrangeHRM system. It extends a base FilterParams class and specifies allowed sorting fields.

classes.name: ReportingMethodSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A data transfer object for filtering reporting method search results, allowing only specific sort fields.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the filter parameters by setting the default sort field to 'rm.name'.
